verdict.rationale: Choosing a specific model instead of automatic selection is a fair question for a coding-agent platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions model selection, an automatic model mode, or pinning a particular model. The session-defaults and session-settings items never say models are among the configurable settings, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice
